name: Heloïse
source: Heloise is cool and calm, yet ephemeral and beautiful. She is like the cool fog over a frozen lake. Enough to draw you in, to kill you in one fatal misstep.
translation: Heloise is cool and calm, yet ephemeral and beautiful. She is like the cool fog over a frozen lake. Enough to draw you in, to kill you in one fatal misstep.
